subject: Aurora Health — on-site visit: stopover impacted demo scheduling
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Velasquez <sara@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aurora Health — on-site visit: stopover impacts demo scheduling

Hi Sara —

Quick follow up after the itinerary you shared: I see your team now has a stopover in Chicago the morning of 11/10 which shortens onsite overlap to ~45 minutes. We can absolutely work with that. Two options that have worked well in the past:

1) Condensed in-person executive overview (30–45 min) on the day you arrive + a recorded deep-dive that we share immediately after.
2) Split the demo: short on-site kickoff (30 min) and a remote technical session the next morning (60 min) so your engineers can join without travel constraints.

Attached is a proposed agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a short SE runbook that outlines remote setup needs. If you prefer option 2 we can schedule the remote slot for the morning after your stopover — Karthik can lead that.

Quick asks: who from your side will attend the on-site portion, and do you want the remote session recorded? If you confirm option 2 I’ll send calendar invites for both slots.

Thanks — looking forward to meeting the team in person.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Sara Velasquez <sara@aurorahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@auroratravel.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -06:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — on-site visit: stopover impacts demo scheduling

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the options and for being flexible. Sorry for the late change — our outbound flight now has a mandatory overnight stop in Chicago, so our availability on 11/10 is limited to a 40–50 minute window in the late afternoon after arrival.

Given our schedule and that our PMs need to travel the next morning, option 2 (split demo) sounds ideal: a short onsite overview on 11/10 and a remote technical deep-dive first thing on 11/11. Yes please record the remote session for the rest of the team who can’t attend.

Attendees for the on-site kickoff: Sara Velasquez (myself), Michael Patel (Head of Integrations), and Lina Gomez (PM). For the remote deep-dive, we’ll add two engineers: Rajiv Shah and Emily Cho.

Can you confirm the on-site start time that best aligns with your team? Also — we’ll need a quiet conference room with projector/HDMI for the on-site slice. I’ve CCed Tom, our travel coordinator, in case the reception needs directions.

Thanks — looking forward to the visit.

— Sara
Director, Product Operations
Aurora Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Velasquez <sara@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@auroratravel.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — on-site visit: stopover impacts demo scheduling

Hannah / team —

Happy to own the remote deep-dive on 11/11. Proposed plan:

• 11/10 16:30 — 17:00 onsite kickoff (Hannah): executive overview, key outcomes, Q&A. We’ll keep slides to 15 minutes and leave 15 minutes for logistics/questions.
• 11/11 09:00 — 10:00 remote deep-dive (Karthik): end-to-end demo (30–40 min), followed by 20 min for integration-specific Q&A. I’ll record the session and upload to the shared drive immediately.

Pre-reqs for the remote session: stable Wi‑Fi in the conference room (we’ll do a quick AV check 10 minutes prior), projector with HDMI or AirPlay for the on-site portion. I’m attaching a short runbook (se-runbook-remote-checklist.md) with connection tests and a brief host checklist.

If those times work I’ll create calendar invites and a Zoom link (no extra software required). Also happy to shorten the remote deep-dive if you prefer 45 minutes instead of 60.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Velasquez <sara@aurorahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Aurora Health — on-site visit: stopover impacts demo scheduling

Thanks everyone — plan confirmed. I’ve booked the two blocks and attached the updated agenda and the runbook. Calendar invites:

• 11/10 16:30–17:00 — Aurora HQ, Conf room B — Executive kickoff (Hannah) — invite sent
• 11/11 09:00–10:00 — Remote deep-dive (Karthik) — Zoom link in invite; session will be recorded

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, se-runbook-remote-checklist.md, aurora-travel-iti.png (your travel screenshot for reference).

Sara — could you confirm the conference room reservation and that projector/HDMI will be available? Also let me know if you’d like the remote session shortened to 45 minutes — we can adapt. We’ll put a short recording consent line in the invite for attendees.

Looking forward to meeting the team in person. Safe travels.

— Hannah
